thag4.11:4.1: This is a difficult line. My reading depends on the speculative emending of the opening _tā_ to _te_. Then _matamada_ is “death-mad”, a fitting epithet for the snake who is the frogs’ predator. The commentary also identifies as snake, but reads _amatamada_, “intoxicated by the deathless”, further explaining _amata_ here as _agada_, “antidote”; but none of this strikes me as very likely.
